name: Umhlaza wamabele namaqhuma
tagline: Ukuzijonga, ukuzivavanya, kwaye wenze ntoni xa ufumana iqhuma.

urgent.heading: Jonga ikliniki kule veki ukuba
urgent.primary_message: Iqhuma elitsha lebele, ukukhutshwa kwengono, ukubola kwesikhumba, okanye utshintsho kwimilo - musa ukulinda. Yijonge. Uninzi alungomhlaza, kodwa ezo zifuna isenzo esikhawulezileyo.
red_flags: Iqhuma elitsha okanye ukujiya ebeleni okanye ekhwapheni
Ukutshintsha ubungakanani, imilo, okanye i-symmetry yebele elinye

what_is_it.heading: Umhlaza wamabele ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Umhlaza wamabele ngumhlaza oqala kwiiseli zebele - ngokwesiqhelo kwimibhobho yobisi okanye kumadlala avelisa ubisi. Uninzi lwamaqhuma amabele ayingomhlaza, kodwa iqhuma ngalinye elitsha lifuna ukujongwa.
paragraphs: Umhlaza wamabele ngowona mhlaza uxhaphakileyo kwabasetyhini baseMzantsi Afrika. Malunga nomntu omnye kwabangama-27 uya kuyiphuhlisa ebomini bakhe. Amadoda anokufumana umhlaza wamabele nawo, nangona unqabile kakhulu - malunga ne-1 kwi-1,000.

Xa ubanjwe kwangethuba - phambi kokuba usasazeke - umhlaza webele uyanyangeka kakhulu. Ukusinda kweminyaka emihlanu kumhlaza wamabele okwinqanaba lokuqala eMzantsi Afrika kungaphezulu kwama-80%. Umceli mngeni eMzantsi Afrika kukubhaqwa emva kwexesha: abasetyhini abaninzi babonana nogqirha kuphela xa umhlaza sele uhambele phambili, xa unyango lunzima kwaye iziphumo ziba mandundu.

items.headline: 1 ku27
items.body: Abasetyhini baseMzantsi Afrika baza kuba nomhlaza wamabele ebomini babo. Umngcipheko ukhuphuka ngokukhawuleza emva kweminyaka engama-50.

items.headline: Uninzi lwamaqhuma aluncedo
items.body: Malunga ne-8 kwi-10 amaqhuma amabele ayingomhlaza - i-cysts, i-fibroadenomas, okanye utshintsho oluqhelekileyo lwebele. Kodwa lonke iqhuma elitsha lisafuna ukuhlolwa.

items.headline: Kwangoko = ukusinda
items.body: Iminyaka emihlanu yokusinda ingaphezulu kwama-80% xa ibanjwe kwangoko, yehla kakhulu xa ifunyenwe emva kwexesha. Ukufunyaniswa kwangoko yeyona nto inkulu kwisiphumo.

items.headline: Uvavanyo lwasimahla
items.body: Iimviwo zamabele zaseklinikhi zasimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki. I-Mammograms yasimahla kwizibhedlele zikaRhulumente kubasetyhini abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-40 kunye nezinto ezinobungozi. Uvavanyo lweselula lwe-CANSA nalo.

pull_quote.text: Uninzi lwamaqhuma amabele ayingomhlaza. Kodwa awukwazi ukuzibona ngokuziva ulilolo. Iqhuma ngalinye elitsha elingasukiyo kumjikelo omnye wokuya exesheni lifanele utyelelo lwasekliniki. Musa 'ukulinda uze ubone' kangangeenyanga.

signs.heading: Yintoni omawuyijonge
signs.lede: Yazi ukuba amabele akho aqhele ukujongeka njani kwaye azive njani. Ukutshintsha kwesiqhelo sakho yinto ebalulekileyo - hayi indlela amabele akho athelekisa ngayo neyomnye umntu.

items.title: Amaqhuma kunye nokujiya
items.description: Iqhuma elitsha ebeleni okanye ekhwapheni. Indawo evakala ngokwahlukileyo - iqinile, ixinene, okanye ijiyile kunethishu ejikelezileyo. Uninzi alungomhlaza kodwa zonke zifuna ukujongwa.

items.title: Utshintsho kwimilo okanye ulusu
items.description: Ibele elinye lijonge ngokwahlukileyo kunangaphambili - ubukhulu, imilo, okanye ukutshintsha indawo. I-Dimpling, puckering, okanye isikhumba se-orenji-peel. Ububomvu obuqhubekayo okanye irhashalala.

items.title: Iingono ziyatshintsha
items.description: Ingono ijikela ngaphakathi (entsha), ukuvuza okungelobisi lwebele (ingakumbi kunegazi okanye kucace kwelinye icala), okanye irhashalala kwingono.

items.myth: Umhlaza wamabele wehlelwa kuphela kwabasetyhini abadala.
items.fact: Umngcipheko ukhuphuka kakhulu emva kweminyaka engama-50, kodwa umhlaza wamabele uyenzeka nakweyiphi na iminyaka. Umhlaza wabasetyhini abancinci uthande ukuba ndlongondlongo - iqela ngalinye lobudala kufuneka lizazi iimpawu.

items.myth: Ukuba akukho mntu kusapho lwam onomhlaza wamabele, ndikhuselekile.
items.fact: Kuphela malunga nomhlaza wamabele om-1 kwali-10 ngokucacileyo onxulunyaniswa nemizila yemfuza. Uninzi lwenzeka kubafazi abangenambali yosapho. Wonke umntu kufuneka azazi iimpawu.

items.myth: Ukunxiba ibra okanye ukusebenzisa ideodorant kubangela umhlaza wamabele.
items.fact: Akukho nokuba kuboniswe ukuba kubangele umhlaza webele kulo naluphi na uphando oluthembekileyo. Ezi ziintsomi eziphazamisana nezinto ezibalulekileyo - ukufunyanwa kwangoko kunye nezinto ezaziwayo zomngcipheko.

Ubungakanani abukuxeleli ukuba iqhuma ngumhlaza. Ezinye ii-cancer ezinobundlobongela zincinci xa zifunyenwe; amaqhuma amaninzi amakhulu ayingomhlaza. Khangela naliphi na iqhuma elitsha - nokuba lingakanani na.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokunciphisa umngcipheko kwaye uyibambe kwangoko
prevention.lede: Eminye imingcipheko awukwazi ukuyitshintsha (iminyaka yobudala, imfuza, isondo). Abaninzi unako. Ukufunyaniswa kwangethuba yeyona nto inamandla yokusinda.

items.title: Yazi isiqhelo sakho
items.description: Jonga kwaye uve amabele akho kanye ngenyanga, ngokufanelekileyo emva kokuba usexesheni. Utshintsho kwisiqhelo sakho yeyona nto ibalulekileyo - ziqhelanise nokuba yintoni 'eqhelekileyo' kuwe.

items.title: Uvavanyo lweklinikhi eklinikhi
items.description: Uvavanyo lwebele lwasimahla kuyo nayiphi na iklinikhi karhulumente - ngonyaka ukusuka kwiminyaka engama-30. Abasebenzi bezempilo bafumana izinto onokuthi uziphose.

items.title: I-mammogram ukusuka kwi-40
items.description: Iimammograms zicetyiswa rhoqo kwiminyaka emi-2 ukusuka kwiminyaka engama-40, ngonyaka ukuba kukho ingozi enkulu. Izibhedlele zikaRhulumente zinika i-mammograms yamahhala kubasetyhini abasengozini.

items.title: Imiba yokuphila
items.description: Gcina ubunzima obunempilo, ukunciphisa utywala (ngaphantsi kwe-1 isiselo ngosuku), sebenza ngokomzimba, uncelise ukuba unako. Oku kunciphisa umngcipheko ngokuthozama kodwa ngokunentsingiselo.

items.title: Ukuba ufumana iqhuma elitsha
items.description: Qaphela xa uyifumene. Bona ikliniki kwiiveki ezimbini ezizayo. Ukuba sele usondele okanye udlulile ekuyekeni ukuya exesheni, sukulinda kuwo nawuphi na 'umjikelo' — bona umntu ngokukhawuleza.

items.title: Zihlole qho ngenyanga
items.description: Kanye ngenyanga, emva kwexesha lakho. Jonga esipilini uphakamise iingalo. Yiva ibele ngalinye kunye nekhwapha xa usenza isangqa. Ukuma nokungqengqa. Imizuzu emihlanu.

items.title: Uvavanyo lweklinikhi lonyaka ukusuka kwi-30
items.description: Ngena kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki. Cela uvavanyo lwebele lwekliniki. Isimahla, ithatha imizuzu, kwaye ifumana izinto ongenakuziva ngokwakho.

items.title: Mammogram ukusuka kwiminyaka engama-40
items.description: Rhoqo kwiminyaka emi-2 ukusuka kuma-40, ngonyaka ukuba kusemngciphekweni omkhulu (imbali yosapho, amabele axineneyo, ufuzo lwe-BRCA). Kuyakhathaza kodwa kuyakhawuleza - kwaye kusindisa ubomi.

items.title: Ukuba ufunyanisiwe - yiya kwiziko lomhlaza
items.description: Unyango lusebenza kakhulu kumaziko amakhulu omhlaza esibhedlele. Buza malunga nokuthunyelwa. I-CANSA inokunceda ukukhangela inkqubo.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Ukhathalelo lomhlaza wamabele eMzantsi Afrika lucwangciswe kakuhle kumaziko amakhulu. Kwangoko kwinkqubo oyifakayo, kokukhona iziphumo zingcono.
